findings.title: Orinda Sun 1957-05-03
findings.creator: Silverman, Herman, 1920-2011
description: Please visit the California Revealed website to see the most complete and up-to-date version of this object: https://californiarevealed.org/node/528430 .

The Orinda Sun Newspapers focus on the unincorporated town of Orinda, California from 1948 to 1972. During this time period Orinda went from a small rural area to a thriving suburb of the SF Bay area. While the Orinda Sun would occasionally run stories about Contra Costa County, California state or national interest, the focus was on articles of local significance like transportation needs (like BART or Highway 24 freeway), development plans, Orinda community events, and culture of the people who had settled in this area through stories, wanted ads, obituaries, wedding and birth announcements and the many ads for local establishments.

description: Please visit the California Revealed website to see the most complete and up-to-date version of this object: https://californiarevealed.org/node/534447 .

The Orinda Sun newspapers focused on the unincorporated town of Orinda, California from 1948 to 1972. During this time period, Orinda went from being a small rural town to a thriving suburb of the San Francisco Bay area. While the Orinda Sun would occasionally run stories about Contra Costa county and statewide or national interests, the focus was on articles of local significance, such as transportation needs (BART, Highway 24), development plans, Orinda community events, and the culture of the people who settled in this area through their stories, want ads, obituaries, wedding and birth announcements, and the many advertisements for local establishments.

creator: Caylus, Anne Claude Philippe, comte de, 1692-1765
Coypel, Charles-Antoine, 1694-1752
Pouget, Jean Henri Prosper, -1769 CMalG
description: Issued without title or imprint. Title from BN

Republished by Basan ca. 1775 with added title leaf, print numbering, and legends giving subjects of gems. Title: Recueil de trois cent têtes et sujets de composition, gravés par Mr. le Cte. de Caylus d'après les pierres gravées antiques du Cabinet du roi

Later published by Basan with title leaf, print numbering, and legends giving subjects of gems, under title: Recueil de trois cent têtes et sujets de composition, gravés par Mr. le Cte. de Caylus d'après les pierres gravées antiques du Cabinet du roi (ca. 1775)

First leaf is etching of Athena staying the arm of Time, signed by C.P. after Ch. Coy. (Charles-Antoine Coypel?). In Getty copy a title has been written on it in brown ink: Pierres gravées du Cabinet du Roy, gravées par M. le C. de C
BN

Mounted on verso of front flyleaf of Getty copy is drawing of a Bacchic scene in red ink (79 x 117 mm.). Mounted on 2nd back flyleaf is etching with drypoint dated 1768 by Pouget depicting a gem; hand-written legend: Septime Severe Pierre antique, du cabinet du Mr. de Douxmesnil (13.8 x 10.3 cm.). Mounted on 1st back flyeaf is etching of a gem depicting "Diane de Tauris," from the collection of the Marquis of Gouvernet (11.8 x 7 cm.)
Binding: red morocco, tooled in gilt. Edges gilt. Yellow ribbon place marker. Round armorial bookplate of Sir David Lionel Salomons, bart
